reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
قُرَيْشٍ is the genitive muḍāf ilayh of إِيلَٰفِ.
The suffix هِمْ is the possessive dependent of إِۦلَٰفِ.
رِحْلَةَ is accusative as the object of the verbal noun إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ.
ٱلشِّتَآءِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayh of رِحْلَةَ.
وَ coordinates ٱلصَّيْفِ with ٱلشِّتَآءِ in the same genitive construction.
لْ is lām al-amr and governs يَعْبُدُوا۟ in the jussive.
رَبَّ is the accusative object of يَعْبُدُوا۟.
هَٰذَا is the genitive dependent completing the construct رَبَّ هَٰذَا.
ٱلْبَيْتِ identifies the demonstrative هَٰذَا as an appositional bayān.
ٱلَّذِىٓ is the nominative relative pronoun subject of أَطْعَمَهُم.
The suffix هُم in أَطْعَمَهُم is the object pronoun governed by أَطْعَمَ.
جُوعٍۢ is governed by مِّن as the complement of أَطْعَمَهُم.
وَ coordinates ءَامَنَهُم with أَطْعَمَهُم as parallel relative predicates.
ٱلَّذِىٓ also supplies the subject of the coordinated verb ءَامَنَهُم.
The suffix هُم in ءَامَنَهُم is the object pronoun governed by ءَامَنَ.
خَوْفٍۭ is governed by مِّنْ as the complement of ءَامَنَهُم.
